title: CI Linux runners: pin jobs to ubuntu-24.04 rather than ubuntu-latest, while keeping ubuntu-slim and macOS runners
answers: Why did CI jobs stop working after GitHub moved ubuntu-latest, and how is the runner pinned?
Which runner should a new Linux GitHub Actions job use: ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04 or ubuntu-slim?
Where is the default runner for the generated flavor matrix jobs set?
Where is the Ubuntu runner choice handled for the lint, docs, or test workflows?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/*.yml (runs-on of every PR, push and scheduled job, e.g. master.yml, lint.yml, docs.yml, typescript.yml) and dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py:get_runs_on, which supplies the default runner for dynamically generated flavor matrix jobs.
Rule: Linux jobs run on `ubuntu-24.04`, not `ubuntu-latest`, because GitHub is migrating `ubuntu-latest` to Ubuntu 26.04 (Oct-Nov 2026). `get_runs_on` falls back to `ubuntu-24.04` when no version-specific `runs_on` is configured. Keep `ubuntu-slim` for lightweight jobs (see the github-actions-style skill), and leave non-Ubuntu runners such as `macos-latest` unchanged.
Constraints: Applies to Linux runners in MLflow CI. Does not apply to `ubuntu-slim` jobs (15-minute timeout) or macOS/Windows jobs. Revisit this pin after the 26.04 migration has been validated, since the pin is a time-boxed workaround and not a permanent choice.
applies: MLflow GitHub Actions workflows and the flavor matrix generator; choosing or changing the runner label for CI jobs.
says: Continuous integration jobs broke unexpectedly after GitHub upgraded the default Linux virtual environment.
Standardize our Linux build pipelines on a specific stable operating system version.
Which virtual machine image should new automated test jobs use for Linux builds?
Keep lightweight automated jobs on slim Linux machines while pinning standard build runners.
Ensure Mac and Windows continuous integration tasks are unaffected by Linux runner adjustments.
search: CI Linux runner configuration pins jobs to ubuntu-24.04 rather than ubuntu-latest across GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml including master.yml, lint.yml, docs.yml, typescript.yml) and dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py:get_runs_on. The get_runs_on helper falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when no version-specific runs_on is configured, as a time-boxed workaround for GitHub migrating ubuntu-latest to Ubuntu 26.04. Applies to MLflow CI Linux runners and flavor matrix generation, while keeping ubuntu-slim for lightweight jobs and leaving macos-latest and Windows jobs unchanged. The pin must be revisited after the 26.04 migration is validated and does not apply to 15-minute timeout ubuntu-slim jobs.
